name: body_context_spans
rule: Recompute the complete sentence and physical-page intersections from the word offsets and original normalized page text. Preserve all text and raw spans. Only intersections containing whitespace exclusively may be absent from the meaningful-page comparison. Require equal non-whitespace character sequence independently on every meaningful physical page, exact failure-pair scope and unchanged financial acceptance. This is not numeric whitespace joining, header stripping, general error suppression or acceptance of dates.
